title: horkelia californica var. elata
intro: Horkelia californica var. elata, commonly known as California horkelia, is a perennial herbaceous plant native to the western United States, specifically in the mountainous regions of California and Oregon. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate various health conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Horkelia californica var. elata are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
